curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the scale of distraction deaths, the three kinds of distraction, the task-switch distance, and prosecution for careless distracted driving.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Danger and distance cards; contrast card linking the switch time to everyday tasks.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on why distraction is a hazard.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what to set up before the trip and what to avoid while driving.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per habit, grouped before-the-trip and while-driving.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on choosing the safest habit.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the hand-held ban, banned uses, fines and the emergency exception.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Law, use and fine cards; contrast card for first versus later fines.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on banned uses and emergency exceptions.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach Kelsey's Law for Level one and two teens, then GPS, hands-free, dash cam and mounted-device allowances.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Allowed-use cards; contrast cards for teen levels and GPS versus a single tap.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what a described driver may do with a device.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach Click It or Ticket, who must buckle, why belts matter, correct fit and the medical exception.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Belt rule and fit cards; contrast cards for the under-sixteen rule and air bags.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on who must be buckled and where.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach car seat and booster age and height lines, installation rules, rear-seat placement and lap and belt sharing bans.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Restraint rule cards; contrast cards for age versus height and rear seat versus rear-facing.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on where and how a described child must ride.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the open pickup bed rule and its exceptions, where to get car seat help, and why to avoid secondhand seats.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Pickup and car seat help cards; contrast card for the under-eighteen and under-sixteen lines.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on pickup bed riders and car seat sources.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec05-m01..sec05-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
